objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed policy or guideline document created, edited, released, distributed, archived, translated, and reactivated in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Workflow or lifecycle status of the document, such as editing, released, or out of force.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released document version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used to calculate the next validity date.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which an invalidated document remains archived before physical deletion.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: User groups or persons with read authorization.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional persons with change rights but no release workflow relevance.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Persons assigned to review the document.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Persons assigned to release the document.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Classification selected when creating a document and used for templates, validity period, and archive duration.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selected when creating a new document.

objs.name: document_version
objs.description: Version of a document created through release, revision, or reactivation and used for signatures and status.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attachment released with the main document and subject to versioning and archiving with the main document.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary object added to a document, released directly through properties, and not subject to the main document release cycle.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal for changing an existing document, created without affecting the document content or version history until scheduled.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document when validity is near expiry and processed with workflow support.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to declare a released document out of force and archive it.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to reactivate an invalidated document.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of user groups and persons assigned to a document for read authorization, notification, acknowledgement, and dashboard assignment.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group used for authorizations, roles, distribution, archive access, and dashboard assignment.

objs.name: person
objs.description: User acting as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, reader, translator, initiator, or acknowledgement recipient.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants during release, validity extension, override, reactivation, or acknowledgement.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature completed by workflow participants and documented for each released version.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: Notification sent by the system about workflow tasks, change proposals, validity extension, distribution, and acknowledgement.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which a document can be specified as visible or not visible.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in the system by attaching a new information object and selecting a document type and optionally a template.

evts.name: maintain_document_property
evts.description: Maintain standardized or customer-specific metadata and authorization attributes in document properties.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Edit document content with the implemented editing client in the local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save a document after content editing.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert a saved document to PDF and display the current version on the web.

evts.name: create_editing_version
evts.description: Automatically create a new editing version when a released document is changed or revised.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Supplement a document with an Additional Info object.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release and publish Additional Info directly through switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete Additional Info directly without creating a new version of the associated document.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Supplement a document with an Attachment object.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an Attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: mark_attachment_for_archiving
evts.description: Mark a released Attachment for archiving.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Archive an Attachment with the release of the next version of the main document or with document archiving.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: Initiate the approval process after document creation, attribute maintenance, content maintenance, and document control definition.

evts.name: sign_creation
evts.description: Registered author signs the creation step in the release workflow.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewer checks document content according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releaser approves the document, causing the document to be released.

evts.name: reject_workflow
evts.description: Reject a review or release task, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish the document after release so it is visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a change proposal for a released or validated document without affecting content or version history.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a change proposal for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Document the editing of an assigned change proposal directly in the change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a change proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request 30 days before the document validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity, delete the validity extension request, and update the valid until date.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension
evts.description: Automatically terminate the validity extension process and delete its request when a revised document version is released or AKS is declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: Create a request for AKS for a selected released document.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Declare a document out of force, keep the AKS request, set the last valid version status to out of force, delete existing edited versions, and revoke rights except archive group.

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Archive an invalidated document and its attachments by withdrawing authorizations rather than physically deleting it.

evts.name: delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete archived documents after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation in the provided folder and select the corresponding document.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Initiator confirms the reactivation workflow step.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Create a new document version, retain metadata and properties from AKS, restore authorizations, and confirm distribution list from the invalidated version.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Reactivate attachments archived with the document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain user groups and persons on the distribution list for a document.

evts.name: notify_distribution_by_email
evts.description: Inform assigned users and user group members by e-mail notification when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request acknowledgement by e-mail when a document with acknowledgement distribution is released.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement through a workflow-supported task without a signature.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released document content into another language.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Check the translated document version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release the translated language version so it becomes visible to authorized readers in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible or not visible.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: Create a new document in a client for a local addition and reference the original document.

o2o.description: A document is created with selection of a corresponding document type.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type.
A template can be selected when creating a new document.
Documents managed in versions have released, editing, revised, or reactivated versions.
Attachments are associated with a main document and controlled with its release and archiving.
Additional Info objects can be added to each document.
A change proposal clearly belongs to a document and is displayed in the document.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document to be checked.
A request for AKS is created for a selected document.
A request for reactivation selects the corresponding invalidated document.
A document has a distribution list maintained in its cockpit.
User groups can be assigned to the distribution list.
Persons can be assigned directly to the distribution list.
User groups are assigned to documents to grant read and change rights.
Persons are assigned to documents as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, reader, or initiator.
Workflow tasks are assigned to workflow participants.
Signatures of workflow participants are documented for each released version.
E-mail notifications inform users involved in workflow, change proposal, distribution, and acknowledgement activities.
A document can be specified as visible or not visible in clients.
A local document can reference the original document.
